residual_note: Studies the classifier kept but whose title or conditions name an anesthesia or procedural term. Retained deliberately: many are psychiatric trials that merely mention a procedural agent (a psychedelic masked with propofol). The exclusion count above is what was removed, not a claim that the category is now empty.

rules.rule: HealingMaps listings NOT tagged as a psychedelic/psychedelic-therapy category (GLP-1, peptide, generic wellness clinics the source also lists)
ClinicalTrials.gov records matching a search term but carrying NO psychedelic intervention (e.g. 'DMT' = disease-modifying therapy in multiple-sclerosis trials)
Studies whose indication is anesthesia/analgesia/procedural-sedation, sharing only a molecule (ketamine) with the therapeutic field
